_README: Networks tracked for the Upstream Transit Carriers measurement.
This file is DATA, not code. The collector reads it and needs no changes.
REBUILT 22 Aug 2026 from the BPH profile pages themselves. An earlier version
scraped every AS number off each page, which swept in the upstream carriers the
profiles document, and a later one leaned on registry holder names, which cannot
see fronts, successors or de-registered assets. The profiles already state the
role of every network. Each entry below carries the sentence it came from.
measured  = the provider's own network: primary, secondary, backbone or front.
successor = where infrastructure moved after an enforcement action. Measured
separately because reconstitution is a different question from survival.
sibling   = related or adjacent, ownership NOT established by the profile.
carrier   = an upstream transit provider. Other people's infrastructure.
excluded  = the profile documents this as a misattribution or disclaims the link.
To move a network between buckets, move its line. No code change needed.
